Port Moody condos for sale: apartment-style homes in strata buildings. The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® benchmark for apartments (condos) in Port Moody was $680,000 in October 2026 (-3.7% over a year). Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.
Port Moody condos sold, November 2025 to October 2026

243 condos sold in Port Moody with a median price of $705,000 (the middle half sold between $605,000 and $799,450), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 97.7% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $789 per square foot, a median year built of 2008 and a median strata fee of $466 a month.

blocks.text: Port Moody Condos: streets and boundaries

items.t: Port Moody's condo stock sits in two station areas, not spread across the city: Suter Brook and Newport Village by Inlet Centre Station on Ioco Road, Klahanie along Klahanie Drive, and the St. Johns Street shelf by Moody Centre Station.

The two SkyTrain stations that organise the stock are Moody Centre Station at 65 Williams Street and Inlet Centre Station on Ioco Road, with St. Johns Street and Clarke Street as the east–west streets below them.

blocks.text: Port Moody Condos: the housing stock

items.t: The newest tower stock is at Suter Brook Village: The Grande, by the Onni Group, at 300 Morrissey Road (units also addressed 305 and 308 Morrissey Road), described by the developer as the final offering in Suter Brook Village, with 1-, 2- and 3-bedroom homes.
Klahanie is a Polygon masterplan on Klahanie Drive mixing apartments and townhomes; its Boardwalk apartment development is at 600 and 700 Klahanie Drive, beside the Canoe Club amenity facility.

The Moody Centre shelf's named strata is Platform by Aragon at 83 Moody Street, at Moody Street and Clarke Street; Aragon's own communities page lists Platform as its Port Moody project, and the development mixes apartment and townhouse forms at one address.
Port Moody condos are freehold strata, not freehold houses: a buyer owns a strata lot and a share of common property, and the Form B is the document that states the strata's position.

blocks.text: Port Moody Condos: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Condo zoning is set parcel by parcel under Port Moody Zoning Bylaw, 2018, No. 2937; multi-residential buildings sit in the bylaw's multi-residential and mixed-use zones, checked on the City ViewPort map.

No Port Moody strata can bar long-term rentals: rental-restriction bylaws have been void province-wide since November 24, 2022, whatever an older building's bylaw package or a directory line still says.

Stratas with five or more lots in Port Moody must hold a depreciation report renewed every five years since July 1, 2024, with no deferral vote — the report is where a Klahanie or Suter Brook buyer checks planned envelope and elevator work.

blocks.text: Port Moody Condos: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Port Moody's current Official Community Plan (OCP) is Bylaw, 2026, No. 3522, adopted April 28, 2026; it repealed Bylaw No. 2955, which older condo disclosure packages still cite.
The public library for every Port Moody condo area is the single Port Moody Public Library at 100 Newport Drive in Newport Village.
Eagle Ridge Hospital, the Tri-Cities community hospital, is inside Port Moody at 475 Guildford Way, east of the condo core.

School catchments here do not follow village lines: School District No. 43 (SD43) assigns by home address, and a locator run for 100 Newport Drive returned Mountain Meadows Elementary, not the central Moody Elementary a Newport buyer would assume.

blocks.text: Port Moody Condos: costs and taxes

items.t: Port Moody's 2026 municipal residential general tax rate is 1.61574 dollars per $1,000 of taxable value, under the Annual Property Tax Rates Bylaw, 2026, No. 3541.
City utilities are a separate bill from property tax: the 2026 utility bill was due February 27, 2026, while property taxes were due July 2, 2026 — a condo buyer budgets both, on top of strata fees.

blocks.text: Port Moody Condos: getting around

items.t: Moody Centre Station combines Millennium Line SkyTrain, West Coast Express commuter rail and a bus exchange at Williams Street — the only Port Moody station with both rail services.
Inlet Centre Station, on Ioco Road, is the SkyTrain-only station serving the Suter Brook, Newport Village and Klahanie condo stock.
Route 160 links Moody Centre Station with Port Coquitlam Station along St. Johns Street and the Barnet Highway, on TransLink's regional transit map.

The West Coast Express runs weekdays only, westbound in the morning and eastbound in the afternoon, between Waterfront and Mission City through Moody Centre — a condo buyer commuting outside those windows is on SkyTrain or bus.

blocks.text: Port Moody Condos: risks and due diligence

items.t: The OCP Natural Environment chapter names flooding, debris flows, erosion, landslip and rockfalls on its hazard maps (OCP Maps 14 and 16) and requires geotechnical investigation on steep slopes before clearing.
Rail noise is a Moody Centre shelf item: the Canadian Pacific Railway tracks run between St.
Forest-interface wildfire risk on the city's north-shore slope is managed under the City Community Wildfire Protection Plan, and the City hazards page points owners to FireSmart Canada.

faq.q: What did condos in Port Moody sell for?
faq.a: 243 condos sold in Port Moody between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $705,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Port Moody?
faq.a: The median was 26 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.7% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos in Port Moody sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 243 condos that sold in Port Moody went for between $605,000 and $799,450, around a median of $705,000.

faq.q: Do condos in Port Moody sell above asking price?
faq.a: 3% of the 243 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.7% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos in Port Moody?
faq.a: Of the 243 sales, 243 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $466.

faq.q: How old are the condos that sold in Port Moody?
faq.a: The median year built was 2008 for the 243 condos sold in Port Moody.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos in Port Moody usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Port Moody had 2 bedrooms, from the 243 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Port Moody communities sold the most condos?
faq.a: By number sold: Port Moody Centre (195), North Shore Pt Moody (38), College Park PM (8), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Port Moody buildings sold the most condos?
faq.a: By number sold: The Grande (14), 50 Electronic Avenue (10), Hue (10), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a condo in Port Moody?
faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for apartments (condos) in Port Moody was $680,000 in October 2026, a modelled price for a typical home and not an average of sales.

faq.q: Did condo prices fall in Port Moody?
faq.a: Over the past year the benchmark fell 4.9%. Over three months it fell 3.2%. A change under 1.5% is not described as a rise or fall.

faq.q: Is Port Moody a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026 houses in Port Moody had a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 20%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos are for sale in Port Moody?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the condos in Port Moody that match what you want.

faq.q: Which Port Moody condos are newest?
faq.a: The Grande at 300 Morrissey Road in Suter Brook Village is the developer-described final offering in that village, by the Onni Group, above the village shops by Inlet Centre Station. Older Klahanie and Moody Centre buildings trade beside it, so compare a Suter Brook resale against the depreciation report and contingency reserve fund (CRF) position of its own strata, not against the newest tower.

No. Polygon's Klahanie masterplan on Klahanie Drive includes apartment buildings as well as townhomes; Boardwalk, at 600 and 700 Klahanie Drive, is the apartment development, with residents' access to the Canoe Club amenity facility. A Klahanie listing's form — apartment or townhouse — changes the strata plan, the parking and the insurance a buyer reviews, so read the form on the listing against the strata plan.

faq.q: Can I rent out a Port Moody condo?
faq.a: Yes, long-term. Since November 24, 2022 no British Columbia strata may enforce a rental-restriction bylaw, so an older Port Moody bylaw package that still prints a rental cap does not bind a new owner. Short-term rentals are different: a strata bylaw can still restrict them, and the registered bylaws attached to the Form B are the document that answers that question for a specific building.

faq.q: Which station serves a Suter Brook condo?
faq.a: Inlet Centre Station, on Ioco Road, is the SkyTrain station for Suter Brook and Newport Village; Moody Centre Station, at Williams Street, serves the St. Johns Street shelf and also carries the West Coast Express. Both are Millennium Line stations on TransLink's regional map.
